event.title: US Announces $1 Billion Security Aid to Colombia as New President Takes Office
event.canonical_title: US Announces $1 Billion Security Aid to Colombia as New President Takes Office
event.summary: The US State Department has announced a $1 billion security assistance package for Colombia following the inauguration of right-wing President Abelardo De La Espriella. In his inaugural address, De La Espriella, who has aligned himself with Donald Trump, committed to combating drug trafficking and implementing austerity measures to boost the economy.
